import tifffile, numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
a = tifffile.imread('/app/input/images/1-162hrhoe2.tif').astype(np.float32)
# gaussian-smoothed background subtraction, find local maxima with min distance 30
bg = ndimage.gaussian_filter(a, 40)
d = a - bg
mx = ndimage.maximum_filter(d, size=31)
peaks = (d == mx) & (d > 300)
lab,n = ndimage.label(peaks)
print('peaks', n)
cents = ndimage.center_of_mass(d, lab, range(1,n+1))
vals = ndimage.maximum(d, lab, range(1,n+1))
for c,v in sorted(zip(cents,vals), key=lambda t:-t[1]):
    print(c, round(v))
EOF

cd /tmp && cat > /tmp/build_pipe.py <<'EOF'
from cellprofiler_core.preferences import set_headless
set_headless()
from cellprofiler_core.pipeline import Pipeline
from cellprofiler_core.modules.images import Images
from cellprofiler_core.modules.metadata import Metadata
from cellprofiler_core.modules.namesandtypes import NamesAndTypes
from cellprofiler_core.modules.groups import Groups
from cellprofiler.modules.identifyprimaryobjects import IdentifyPrimaryObjects
from cellprofiler.modules.exporttospreadsheet import ExportToSpreadsheet
import sys

def build(diameter=(60,300), thr_method='Otsu', discard_border=True, correction=1.0, smoothing=2.0, out_prefix='MyExpt_'):
    pipeline = Pipeline()
    im = Images(); im.set_module_num(1); pipeline.add_module(im)
    md = Metadata(); md.set_module_num(2); pipeline.add_module(md)
    nt = NamesAndTypes(); nt.set_module_num(3)
    nt.settings()[0].value = 'All images'
    nt.settings()[1].value = 'Grayscale image'
    nt.settings()[2].value = 'DNA'
    pipeline.add_module(nt)
    gr = Groups(); gr.set_module_num(4); pipeline.add_module(gr)
    ip = IdentifyPrimaryObjects(); ip.set_module_num(5)
    s = ip.settings()
    s[0].value = 'DNA'
    s[1].value = 'Nuclei'
    s[2].value = diameter
    s[3].value = True
    s[4].value = discard_border
    s[17].value = 'Global'
    s[18].value = thr_method
    s[19].value = smoothing
    s[20].value = correction
    s[24].value = 'Two classes'
    pipeline.add_module(ip)
    ex = ExportToSpreadsheet(); ex.set_module_num(6)
    e = ex.settings()
    e[6].value = False
    e[7].value = 'Default Output Folder'
    e[14].value = True
    e[15].value = out_prefix
    e[16].value = True
    pipeline.add_module(ex)
    return pipeline

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import json
    cfg = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    p = build(**cfg)
    with open(sys.argv[2], 'w') as f:
        p.dump(f)
    print('written', sys.argv[2])
EOF
